summary.text: Richard White is a Republican state representative who has represented District 99 since March 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Richard White was born on November 4, 1952, in Fort Meade, Maryland.
He has professional experience as a business owner, president, and developer.

In the 2025-2026 session he serves as vice chair of the House Natural Resources and Energy Committee and sits on the Small Business and Information Technology and the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation committees.
